errors.evidence: The description claims the categories on the horizontal axis are in alphabetical order. The categories are "Крайно потребление", "Брутни инвестиции", "Износ", and "Внос". Their first letters in Bulgarian Cyrillic are К, Б, И, В, which are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: като легендата в долната част на диаграмата ясно разграничава двете групи по цветове и периоди
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the legend distinguishes the two groups (EC-15 and EC-13) by color. The legend distinguishes the two time periods (2000-2008 and 2009-2018) by color, while the country groups are separated by their position on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: като във всяка категория се визуализират два отделни компонента – един за EC-15 и един за EC-13, които са групирани едно до друго
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misunderstanding of the chart's structure. The chart does not group bars for EC-15 and EC-13 together within each economic category. Instead, the chart is divided into two main sections along the x-axis: one for EC-15 and one for EC-13. Within each of these sections, bars are grouped by time period for each of the four economic categories.

errors.text_span: а най-ниските – за „Крайно потребление“ в EC-15 за периода 2000–2008 г. (около 2,2%)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the lowest bar. The bar for "Крайно потребление" in EC-15 for 2000–2008 has a value of approximately 2.3%, which is not the lowest on the chart. The actual lowest values are approximately 0.7%, seen for "Брутни инвестиции" in both EC-15 and EC-13 during the 2009-2018 period.
